items.title: The presheaf colimit construction agrees with f_! for separated locally quasi-finite morphisms

items.difficulty_reason: 14 行（含 12 行陈述）、分离 lqf 的预层构造与 f_! 一致：局部闭有限 over V 经分离性为闭浸入 + 有限并封闭 colimit directed + directed colimit 显式化为 finite 支集截面集 + proper over V 即 finite over V（lqf）按定义等于 f_!F(V)。无 omit，全显示推理；陈述中的 (!) 为作者对预层级同构的强调标注非缺口。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-finite-support-f-shriek-separated (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1118-1129

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for V in Y_etale a locally closed subset finite over V is a closed immersion into X_V by separatedness of f, finite unions of such closed subschemes remain finite over V so the colimit defining f_{p!}F(V) is directed and equals the set of sections with support finite over V; since closed subsets proper over V are finite over V when f is locally quasi-finite this equals f_!F(V) by definition (source lines 1131-1145)
